This Claim Petition is filed by the Petitioners against the Respondent under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act seeking Compensation of 50,00,000/ for the death of Sri. Rama Murthy S/o Late Hanumantharayappa in a Road Traffic accident.

The substance of averments made in the Petition is as under:
That on 07.10.2020 at about 12.40 p.m., the husband of the Petitioner No.1 by name Rama Murthy was proceeding by riding his motorcycle bearing Reg.No.KA43H 8869 near Vivekananda School, Hesaraghatta main road, Bengaluru and at that time one motorcycle bearing Reg.No.KA52H5600 ridden by its rider at high speed and in a rash and negligent manner came from the opposite direction and dashed against the deceased's motorcycle.
Due to this impact, said Rama Murthy was fell down and sustained grievous injuries.

Immediately, after the accident, said Rama Murthy was taken to Medicare Hospital,
Bengaluru for treatment and despite to treatment, he was succumbed to the said injuries on 07.10.2020.
After the death, the body was shifted to MS Ramaiah hospital and Postmortem was conducted and then SCCH 15 4 MVC No.3788/2022 body was handed over to the Petitioners.

Petitioners had spent huge amount towards medical,
funeral and obsequies ceremonies.
3. Prior to the date of accident, the deceased was hale and healthy and he was working as Secretary at Milk Dairy, Kasaghatta and was earning Rs.35,000/ p.m.,
The Petitioners were entirely depending upon the income of the deceased.
Due to the death of Rama Murthy the Petitioners have lost their bread earner.
The Respondent is the owner of the offending motorcycle bearing Reg.No.KA43W8275.
Therefore, the Respondent is liable to pay compensation to the Petitioners.
4. In pursuance of service of notice to the Respondent, she did not appear before the Court.

Hence,
she was placed ex parte.

6. Now the point arises for the determination of this Court are as under : Points 1. Whether the Petitioners prove that Sri. Rama Murthy S/o Late Hanumantharayappa was died in the Road Traffic Accident which occurred on 07.10.2020 at about 12.40 p.m. near Vivekananda School, Hesaraghatta main road, Bengaluru, due to the rash and negligent riding of the motorcycle bearing Reg.No.KA52 H5600 by its rider ?
2. Whether the Petitioners further prove that they are the legal heirs of deceased Sri. Rama Murthy?
3. Whether the Petitioners are entitled for the compensation as prayed for?
If yes, what is the quantum and who is liable to pay ?

Since, the Respondent was placed exparte, there is no Respondent side evidence.

Point No.1 : In the Negative.
Point No.2 : In the Affirmative Point No.3 : In the Negative.

11. It is the contention of the Petitioners that the Ramamurthy was died in the Road Traffic Accident which occurred by the rash and negligent riding of the rider of the motorcycle bearing Reg.No.KA52H5600.

Upon going through the FIR and Complaint i.e., Ex.P23 and 24 shows that on the Complaint lodged by one Basavaraju S/o Puttaiah before Jalahalli Traffic Police Station, the PSI of the concerned Police Station has registered the case against the rider of the motorcycle bearing Reg.No.KA43H8869 for the offences punishable under Sec.279 and 304(A) of IPC.
Ex.P25 is the Spot panchanama with Sketch which shows that the concerned police had drawn mahazar at the spot in the presence of panchas.
Ex.P26 is the IMV report which shows that the SCCH 15 9 MVC No.3788/2022 accident does not occurred due to any mechanical defects of the motorcycles bearing Reg.No.KA43 H8869 and KA52H5600.
Ex.P27 is the Inquest mahazar of the deceased Rama Murthy.

Ex.P1 is the Vehicle Seizer mahazar which shows that P.I of Jalahalli Traffic Police Station, Bengaluru had seized the motorcycle bearing Reg.No.KA43H8869 at the police station by drawing the mahazar in the presence of panchas.
Ex.P2 is the PM report which shows that the cause of death is due to Respiratory failure as a result of interstitial Pneumonitis consequent upon head injury sustained.

Ex.P28 is the Certified copy of Charge sheet which shows that after thorough investigation, the I.O of Jalahalli Traffic Police Station has submitted Abated Chargesheet against the deceased Rama Murthy for the offences punishable under Sec. 279 and 304(A) of IPC and u/s 3(1), 181, 146 and 196 of IMV Act.

Upon going through the Chargesheet i.e., Ex.P28 Column No.17 reads as under :

13. Upon going through the Charge sheet, it clearly shows that on the alleged date of accident i.e., on 07.10.2020 at about 12.40 p.m., the deceased Rama Murthy being the rider of the motorcycle bearing Reg.No.KA43H8869 ridden his motorcycle from Guddadahalli side towards Hesaraghatta with a rash and negligent manner and dashed against the motorcycle bearing Reg.No.
KA52H5600 from the opposite direction and caused the accident.
As a result, the rider of the both motorcycles had fell down and sustained grievous injuries and subsequently they were succumbed to the injuries in the accident.
So, it clearly shows that the said accident has occurred by the rash and SCCH 15 12 MVC No.3788/2022 negligent riding of the deceased Rama Murthy himself.
Therefore, I.O has submitted Abated Charge sheet against the deceased Rama Murthy.

14. But, the Petitioners being the wife and children of deceased Rama Murthy had filed the present petition under Sec.166 of IMV Act claiming compensation for the death of Rama Murthy in the said RTA.

But, the materials available on record clearly shows that the said accident has been occurred by the rash and negligent riding of the motorcycle bearing Reg.No.KA43H8869 by the deceased Rama Murthy himself.
Moreover, Chargesheet was also filed against deceased Rama Murthy for riding the motorcycle without holding DL and without having insurance to the said motorcycle.
The Spot sketch shows that from the spot there was 10 ft distance towards Southern side and 15 ft distance towards Northern side.
The deceased Rama Murthy came from Guddahalli towards Hesaraghatta and the deceased Devaraj came from SCCH 15 13 MVC No.3788/2022 Hesaraghatta towards Guddahalli.
So, it clearly shows the deceased Devaraju was proceeding on the left side of the road and deceased Rama Murthy came to the right side and dashed against the motorcycle bearing Reg.No.KA52H5600.
So, it is crystal clear that the said accident has been occurred by the rash and negligent riding of the deceased Rama Murthy himself.
Therefore, the Petitioners have failed to prove the said accident caused by the rash and negligent riding of the rider of the motorcycle bearing Reg.No.KA52H5600.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the 'Negative'.

sentences.text: Point No.2:
The Petitioner No.1 is the wife and Petitioner No.2 and 3 are the children of the deceased Rama Murthy.
To prove their relationship with the deceased, PW.1 has produced Aadhaar cards of Petitioner No.1 to 3 and deceased at Ex.P.29 to 32.
The same shows the relationship between the SCCH 15 14 MVC No.3788/2022 Petitioners and the deceased.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.2 "in the Affirmative".
16. Point No.3:
In view of detailed discussion in Point No.1, the Petitioners have failed to prove the rash and negligent riding of the rider of the offending motorcycle bearing Reg.No.KA43H5600.
Hence, the Petitioners are not entitled any compensation.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.3 "in the Negative".
17. Point No.4:
In view of my findings on Point No.1 to 3, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER The Claim Petition filed by the Petitioners against the Respondent U/S 166 of M.V. Act is hereby dismissed with costs.
Draw Award accordingly.
